purpose: Expanded public-literature strategic disconnection sources for recurring medicinal-chemistry, natural-product, and semisynthesis route families. These records are high-level route priors, not executable reaction procedures.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template promotion
risk tags for regioselectivity, stereoselectivity, safety, legality, and protecting-group burden
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid operational conditions and quantities
regulated or toxic target families require project-level permission and compliance review before proposal generation

families.name: Spiroketals, polyether ladders, and spiroacetal natural products
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect spiroketals to masked dihydroxy-ketone, hydroxy-enol-ether, or ketalization cascade precursors. Treat spirocenter stereochemistry and thermodynamic versus kinetic control as route-defining metadata.
negative_signals: spiroketal ring left intact through only protecting-group changes
no plan for anomeric or nonanomeric spirocenter selectivity
polyether ladder fragmented without stereochemical or cascade rationale

families.name: Flavonoids, chalcones, flavanones, and chromones
families.strategic_principle: Expose the C6-C3-C6 flavonoid logic: split to substituted acetophenone/benzaldehyde chalcone precursors or to beta-diketone intermediates for chromone/flavone closure.

families.name: Coumarins and 2H-chromenone scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect the benzopyrone to salicylaldehyde/phenol plus activated carbonyl partners. Track whether the target substitution pattern points to Pechmann, Knoevenagel, Perkin, or Kostanecki-type annulation.

families.name: Lignans, neolignans, and phenylpropanoid dimers
families.strategic_principle: Map lignans to two C6-C3 phenylpropanoid units and choose oxidative coupling, conjugate addition, or lactonization logic before late O-methylation/O-demethylation edits.

families.name: Steroid drugs and non-bufadienolide semisynthesis
families.strategic_principle: Treat the steroid tetracycle as a chiral-pool or convergent core unless total synthesis is explicitly requested. Prioritize side-chain, oxidation-state, halogenation, and lactone/ester edits with clear stereochemical lineage.

families.name: Porphyrins, chlorins, and tetrapyrrole macrocycles
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect tetrapyrrole macrocycles to pyrrole/aldehyde condensation partners or open-chain biladiene precursors. Preserve meso substitution symmetry and oxidation-state control.

families.name: Quinolones, fluoroquinolones, and 4-quinolone medicinal scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Build the 3-carboxy-4-quinolone core by named annulation logic, then handle N1, C6 fluorine, C7 amine, and C3 carboxyl modifications as scaffold decoration with explicit SAR and regioselectivity tags.

families.name: Sulfonamides, sulfones, sulfonyl ureas, and sulfur medicinal motifs
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect S-N and S-C sulfur(VI) linkages to sulfonyl chloride/sulfinate/sulfur dioxide equivalents plus amine or carbon partners. Flag sulfonyl chloride availability as a major route constraint.

families.name: Nucleotide analogues and phosphoramidate ProTide prodrugs
families.strategic_principle: Separate nucleoside construction from phosphate or phosphoramidate prodrug masking. Track P-stereochemistry, aryl/amino-acid ester identity, and enzymatic activation liabilities.

families.name: Organofluorine and late-stage fluorination motifs
families.strategic_principle: Treat C-F and CF3 installation as strategic functional-group installation choices, not as generic halogen decoration. Choose between early fluorinated building blocks and late-stage fluorination based on regioselectivity and functional-group tolerance.

families.name: C-glycosides and SGLT2-inhibitor-like aryl C-glucosides
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect the sugar-aglycone C-C bond to a protected or native sugar partner plus aryl/heteroaryl aglycone. Track beta selectivity, protecting-group economy, and whether a chemical or enzymatic C-glycosylation route is intended.

families.name: Cannabinoid and prenylated resorcinol meroterpenoid scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: For compliance-reviewed projects only, map cannabinoid-like meroterpenoids to a polyketide resorcinol acid and a prenyl/monoterpene fragment. Keep enzymatic prenylation/cyclization and controlled-substance constraints explicit.

families.name: Tropane and granatane alkaloid cores
families.strategic_principle: Expose the bicyclic tropane core as a Mannich/cascade or tropinone-anchor problem before ester or N-substituent diversification. Regulated/toxic targets require compliance review.

families.name: Xanthones, anthraquinones, and aromatic polyketide oxygenated scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Map xanthone/anthraquinone frameworks to benzophenone, diaryl ether, or polyketide-folding precursors. Treat oxidation-state and phenol protection order as central route constraints.

anchors.name: o-Hydroxy aryl carbonyl plus activated methylene/carbonyl partner
Pyrrole plus aldehyde / open-chain tetrapyrrole precursor
Sulfonyl chloride / sulfinate plus amine or carbon partner
Nucleoside plus aryl amino-acid phosphoramidate mask
Sugar plus aryl/heteroaryl aglycone C-glycoside precursor
Benzophenone / diaryl ether / anthraquinone aromatic polyketide precursor

disconnections.name: Spiroketal to dihydroxy-ketone ketalization precursor

target_features: two oxygen heterocycles sharing a spiro carbon

break_bonds: one or both C-O bonds at spiroketal center
forward_logic: prepare a dihydroxy ketone or masked hydroxy hemiketal precursor
close the spiroketal under acid, oxidative, or cascade conditions
evaluate whether the desired stereoisomer is thermodynamic or kinetic
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose the ketalization precursor and spirocenter selectivity; flag intact-spiroketal protecting-group loops.

risks: nonanomeric stereoisomer may need kinetic control

evidence.citation: Recent Synthetic Approaches Toward Non-anomeric Spiroketals in Natural Products.
Spiroketal natural product synthesis often uses acid-catalysed cyclisation of dihydroxyketone precursors.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when precursor simplification and spirocenter control are explicit

break_bonds: C-O bonds formed by epoxide opening or oxocarbenium cyclization cascade
forward_logic: assemble linear polyol or polyepoxide precursor
use sequential cyclization or epoxide-opening logic to build ether rings
close spiroketal last if it controls conformation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Generate as strategic prior only when stereochemical relay and leaving-group positions can be mapped.

evidence.citation: Asymmetric synthesis review summarizes diverse strategies for naturally occurring spiroketals.
Chroman spiroketal strategies include cascade cyclization approaches.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate when cascade simplification is chemically mapped

target_features: aryl enone or saturated flavanone core

forward_logic: condense substituted acetophenone with substituted benzaldehyde
cyclize 2-hydroxychalcone to flavanone or oxidize/cyclize to flavone
preserve phenol protection plan
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose acetophenone/benzaldehyde fragments and account for phenol substitution.

evidence.citation: Chalcone chemistry review describes chalcones as flavonoid bioprecursors and synthetic scaffolds.
Stereoselective flavonoid synthesis overview discusses 2-hydroxychalcones as building blocks for flavanones and flavones.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for correct C6-C3-C6 fragment exposure

break_bonds: aryl ester to beta-diketone rearrangement precursor
forward_logic: prepare o-hydroxyacetophenone ester
rearrange to beta-diketone
cyclodehydrate to chromone/flavone
suggested_precursor_roles: aryl acid chloride or ester partner
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use when a chromone/flavone substitution pattern matches beta-diketone annulation better than chalcone cyclization.

evidence.citation: Flavone synthesis overview describes Baker-Venkataraman beta-diketone formation followed by cyclisation.
Flavones and related compounds review covers Kostanecki and related flavone syntheses.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for beta-diketone annulation with substitution tracking

break_bonds: C-C bond formed during benzopyrone annulation
forward_logic: map target to phenol/salicylaldehyde/o-hydroxyaryl ketone and beta-ketoester/malonate/acid anhydride partner
choose Pechmann, Knoevenagel, Perkin, or Kostanecki-like annulation based on substitution pattern
delay sensitive substituent installation if annulation conditions are harsh
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that choose the annulation mode from substitution pattern instead of generic lactone cleavage.

evidence.citation: Coumarin review notes Pechmann and Knoevenagel among classical methods to access coumarin derivatives.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when annulation mode and precursor substitution pattern match

break_bonds: central C-C bond between phenylpropanoid units
forward_logic: prepare phenylpropanoid monomer pair
perform oxidative coupling chemically, enzymatically, or biomimetically
adjust O-methylation and oxidation state after dimer skeleton is set
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward phenylpropanoid dimer exposure with regioselectivity tags; penalize unrelated aryl cleavage.

evidence.citation: Lignan synthesis review discusses oxidative dimerization and oxidative coupling approaches.
Oxidative transformations of lignans include aryl-aryl and aryl-benzyl oxidative coupling examples.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for correct phenylpropanoid monomer mapping

forward_logic: assemble dibenzylbutane or aryl-tetralin precursor
form lactone or ring closure after stereochemistry is set
use oxidative coupling or conjugate addition only when substitution pattern supports it
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not accept late O-methyl edits as strategic progress unless the central lignan skeleton is simplified.

evidence.citation: Lignan pharmacology and synthesis review summarizes main approaches to lignan synthesis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for skeleton simplification with stereochemical plan

break_bonds: none at the steroid tetracycle for first-pass semisynthetic planning
forward_logic: select reviewed steroid core with matching stereochemical series
install side-chain and oxidation-state differences by known steroid transformations or biocatalysis
only consider de novo tetracycle synthesis when explicitly required
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use as an anchor/rerank feature; reject arbitrary product-like steroid analogues as solved stock.

evidence.citation: Synthetic steroids article notes semisynthesis remains primary for pharmaceutically relevant steroids while de novo routes exist.

use_policy.stock_policy: reviewed anchor only; not arbitrary vendor analogue
use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when route explains transformations from core to target

disconnections.name: Steroid side-chain and late-stage oxidation/halogenation edits

break_bonds: late ester/lactone side-chain bonds when present
forward_logic: match target to nearest reviewed steroid core
plan oxidation, reduction, halogenation, or esterification sequence
require evidence for site-selective C-H or biocatalytic oxidation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Classify these as late functionalization edits, not as a skeleton-solving route.

evidence.citation: Synthetic steroids discussion contrasts semisynthetic and de novo strategies for steroid skeletons.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only when paired with a valid steroid core anchor

disconnections.name: Porphyrin macrocycle to pyrrole plus aldehyde condensation

break_bonds: meso carbon-pyrrole bonds formed by aldehyde/pyrrole condensation
forward_logic: condense pyrrole with aldehyde or dipyrromethane partners
oxidize porphyrinogen/chlorin-like intermediate to porphyrin as needed
use symmetry to reduce precursor count when valid
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward aldehyde/pyrrole exposure and symmetry reasoning; flag impossible unsymmetrical substitution without stepwise plan.

evidence.citation: Meso-arylporphyrin synthesis review describes Rothemund, Adler-Longo, and Lindsey strategies.
Porphyrin synthesis review describes Lindsey two-step pyrrole/aldehyde condensation and oxidation.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for correct pyrrole/aldehyde condensation mapping

forward_logic: assemble dipyrromethane or biladiene fragments stepwise
macrocyclize and oxidize/reduce to target tetrapyrrole oxidation state
introduce metals after macrocycle formation if needed
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use for unsymmetrical tetrapyrroles where one-pot aldehyde/pyrrole condensation would scramble substituents.

evidence.citation: Porphyrin synthesis review covers cyclization of open-chain tetrapyrroles such as a,c-biladienes.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for unsymmetrical substitution control

break_bonds: quinolone ring C-C/C-N bonds formed by annulation
forward_logic: prepare anilinomethylene malonate, aminoacrylate, or beta-ketoester anilide precursor
cyclize to 4-quinolone core by Gould-Jacobs, Conrad-Limpach, Grohe-Heitzer, or related route
install N1/C6/C7 substitutions in an order compatible with electronics
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward named quinolone annulation and substitution-order rationale; flag generic aryl-amide edits that do not build the core.

evidence.citation: Quinolone synthesis article notes Gould-Jacobs and Grohe-Heitzer as effective routes to 3-substituted 4-quinolones.
Green Chemistry report describes Gould-Jacobs access to quinolone scaffolds and process drawbacks.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for core annulation with substituent mapping

disconnections.name: Fluoroquinolone C7 amine and C3 carboxyl diversification

forward_logic: prepare activated quinolone core with suitable leaving group at C7
install cyclic amine or other C7 substituent
modify C3 carboxylate only when pharmacophore and solubility consequences are tracked
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Treat C7/C3 edits as late scaffold diversification after a credible quinolone core route exists.

risks: metal chelation and pharmacophore loss at C3
antibacterial stewardship/compliance review for antibiotic analogues

evidence.citation: Quinolone antibiotics review highlights C7 piperazine and C6 fluorine as major modifications.
Fluoroquinolone derivative review notes modification sites including C7 piperazinyl and C3 positions.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only after core annulation is solved

disconnections.name: Sulfonamide S-N disconnection to sulfonyl partner plus amine

forward_logic: prepare or generate sulfonyl chloride, sulfonyl fluoride, sulfinate, or sulfur dioxide equivalent
couple with amine under compatibility-aware conditions
handle sulfonyl ureas by staging isocyanate/carbamate or urea linkage formation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit sulfonyl partner availability; do not treat S-N formation as a generic amide coupling.

risks: sulfonyl chloride preparation can dominate route feasibility

evidence.citation: Sulfur-containing scaffolds review discusses sulfonamides and the common use and limitations of sulfonyl chlorides.
Sulfonamide drug review states common preparation from sulfonyl chloride and ammonia/amine.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for feasible sulfonyl partner plus amine split

disconnections.name: Sulfone C-S disconnection and oxidation-state strategy

break_bonds: intramolecular S-N or S-C bond for sultams
forward_logic: choose sulfinate substitution/coupling or thioether formation followed by oxidation
avoid late oxidation when other oxidizable groups are unprotected
stage ring closure for sultams after sulfonamide installation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Track sulfur oxidation state explicitly; sulfide-to-sulfone oxidation is not a skeleton simplification by itself.

evidence.citation: Sulfur-containing pharmaceutical scaffolds review covers sulfones and sulfonamide synthesis approaches.
Review of sulfenamide/sulfinamide/sulfonamide formation discusses oxidative routes from thiols and amines.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for feasible sulfinate/thioether logic with oxidation risk tags

forward_logic: prepare nucleoside core separately
install phosphoramidate masking group with P-stereochemistry tracked
verify that proposed aryl and amino-acid ester match activation requirements
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Require P-stereochemistry, leaving-group identity, and activation-pathway metadata before promotion.

evidence.citation: ProTide miniperspective discusses phosphoramidate prodrug technology from concept to clinic.
Review of antiviral nucleotide prodrugs describes phosphoramidate ProTide approaches.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when nucleoside core and phosphoramidate mask are separated with stereochemical metadata

disconnections.name: Nucleoside core before nucleotide/prodrug masking

break_bonds: phosphate ester or phosphonate prodrug bonds
forward_logic: solve nucleoside or carbocyclic nucleoside core first
add phosphate/phosphonate/prodrug group after compatible protecting-group setup
avoid treating a masked nucleotide as ordinary stock without activation rationale
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Route scoring should separate nucleoside skeleton construction from prodrug masking edits.

risks: biological activation not implied by synthesis

evidence.citation: Phosphoramidate/phosphonamidate ProTide review summarizes antiviral pronucleotide strategies and activation studies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for clean separation of core synthesis and phosphate masking

disconnections.name: Aryl fluoride late-stage C-F installation

target_features: fluorine as metabolic or imaging substituent

break_bonds: aryl C-F bond to aryl leaving-group or C-H precursor
forward_logic: choose early fluorinated building block or late-stage fluorination precursor
map aryl halide/triflate/boronate/C-H precursor to appropriate fluorination logic
for radiochemistry, enforce short-time and isotope-specific constraints as metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Late fluorination is a strategic option only when regioselectivity and functional-group tolerance are credible.

risks: metal residue or harsh reagent risk

evidence.citation: Late-stage fluorination review describes C-F formation in complex molecules and PET tracer constraints.
Catalysis review discusses fluorination and trifluoromethylation method development.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate when fluorination precursor and selectivity are explicit

disconnections.name: Deoxyfluorination and trifluoromethyl installation disconnection

break_bonds: C-F or C-CF3 bond to alcohol/carbonyl/halide/boronate precursor
forward_logic: use deoxyfluorination when an alcohol precursor preserves carbon skeleton
use trifluoromethylation precursor logic for aryl/heteroaryl CF3 targets
track stereochemical inversion/retention and competing elimination
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Prefer fluorinated building blocks when late-stage fluorination selectivity is not defensible.

risks: scale and safety of fluorinating reagents

evidence.citation: Late-stage fluorination review surveys fluorination approaches for pharmaceutical and agrochemical molecules.
Catalysis for fluorination and trifluoromethylation review discusses unmet needs and method classes.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low_to_moderate unless selectivity evidence is strong

target_features: sugar anomeric carbon attached by C-C bond

break_bonds: anomeric carbon to aryl/heteroaryl carbon bond
forward_logic: prepare sugar-derived electrophile/nucleophile or native sugar-compatible precursor
couple to aryl/heteroaryl aglycone with beta selectivity
deprotect or edit sugar after C-C bond formation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not confuse C-glycosides with O-glycosides; require C-C bond strategy and beta-selectivity metadata.

evidence.citation: Native-saccharide aryl beta-C-glycoside synthesis article notes SGLT2 and natural C-glycoside interest.
Glycoside-based antidiabetic review discusses C-glycosides and SGLT2 inhibitor examples.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit sugar-aglycone C-C strategy

disconnections.name: Chemoenzymatic C-glycosyltransferase disconnection

break_bonds: anomeric C-C bond formed by C-glycosyltransferase
forward_logic: synthesize aglycone chemically
use C-glycosyltransferase or chemoenzymatic route for sugar installation
screen enzyme substrate scope before treating as reliable proposal
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use only when enzyme precedent or substrate-scope evidence supports the aglycone class.

risks: scale-up and isolation of polar products

evidence.citation: C-glycosyltransferase substrate-promiscuity study demonstrates chemoenzymatic synthesis of bioactive C-glycosides.
C-H glycosylation article discusses scalable late-stage C-glycosylation and SGLT2 inhibitor discovery.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate when enzyme evidence is attached

forward_logic: map aromatic portion to polyketide resorcinol acid logic
map terpenoid portion to geranyl/prenyl donor logic
treat downstream cyclization/oxidation as separate compliance-reviewed transformations
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: High-level advisory only; regulated or psychoactive targets require project approval before proposal expansion.

evidence.citation: Plant terpenoid review describes cannabinoid structure as GDP-derived monoterpene backbone plus polyketide resorcinol ring.
Cannabinoid biosynthesis review discusses olivetolic acid pathway and cannabinoid biosynthetic logic.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless project is compliance-approved and evidence-rich

break_bonds: C-C bonds formed by Mannich/cascade construction of bicyclic core
forward_logic: expose tropinone or intramolecular Mannich precursor as core anchor
install ester or side-chain substituent after stereochemical core is set
separate regulated/toxic target handling from generic scaffold recognition
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward tropane core simplification; do not generate regulated-substance procedures.

evidence.citation: Tropane alkaloid review describes bicyclic skeleton formation by intramolecular Mannich reaction in biosynthesis.
Cocaine historical review describes Robinson's one-pot tropinone synthesis as a classic tropane core construction.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for core simplification in approved medicinal contexts

disconnections.name: Tropane ester and N-substituent late diversification

forward_logic: reach reviewed tropane alcohol or ketone core
set alcohol stereochemistry before acylation
install ester or N-substituent as late diversification only after core route is credible
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Late ester edits are not sufficient strategic progress without a tropane core anchor.

evidence.citation: Tropane chemistry review covers biosynthesis, pharmacology, and production of tropane alkaloids.
Asymmetric tropinone synthesis article uses intramolecular Mannich cyclization logic for substituted tropanes.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low_to_moderate and only after core anchor

disconnections.name: Xanthone to benzophenone/diaryl ether cyclodehydration precursor

break_bonds: aryl carbonyl bond to benzophenone precursor
forward_logic: prepare 2-hydroxybenzophenone or diaryl ether precursor
cyclodehydrate or Friedel-Crafts acylate to xanthone core
plan phenol protection and oxidation state before ring closure
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward xanthone ring opening to benzophenone/diaryl ether only when phenol substitution and oxidation states are mapped.

evidence.citation: Xanthone anticancer review discusses cyclization and Friedel-Crafts approaches to xanthone derivatives.
Polycyclic xanthone review summarizes structures, biosynthesis, and synthetic approaches.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for correct benzophenone or diaryl ether precursor mapping

disconnections.name: Anthraquinone/polyketide folding and xanthone rearrangement logic

target_features: highly oxygenated anthracene or xanthone core

forward_logic: recognize aromatic polyketide origin from oxygenation pattern
use anthraquinone or benzophenone-like precursor as strategic anchor
treat oxidative cleavage/rearrangement as review-only unless enzyme or literature precedent exists
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use as route critique and anchor guidance; do not invent complex oxidative rearrangements without precedent.

risks: biosynthetic precedent may not translate chemically

evidence.citation: Xanthone biosynthesis review describes polyacetate/polymalonate pathways and benzophenone/anthraquinone-related origins.
Regioselectivity study reports anthraquinone precursor fissions in xanthone biosynthesis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low_to_moderate unless explicit precedent is attached

source_notes.summary: This v2 expansion adds source-backed strategic families that are common in route critique but underrepresented in generic reaction-template systems: heterocycle annulations, semisynthetic cores, sulfur(VI) medicinal motifs, phosphoramidate prodrugs, organofluorine installation, C-glycosides, and biosynthesis-aware natural-product anchors.

Cannabinoid and tropane records are compliance-gated, high-level structural priors. They should not be converted into operational proposal generators without project authorization, legal review, and safety review.
